admission.justification: Guarded by dirty two-page resume and leaf-precedence tests, prevents false unverifiable currentness reports when a paired code tree was resolved, and forms half of the automatic code-tree pairing family guarantee.

applicability: Fresh and continuation-resumed paged knowledge_read walks over converted memory trees.
conditions: Fresh reads forward the resolved context code_tree_id and captured dirty working-tree object_directory through _fresh_read and _at_code_tree.
Resumed reads over working-tree captures re-capture and re-verify the working tree in _resumed_working_tree, preserving object_directory when unchanged and refusing when mutated.
exclusions: Does not mask a mutated working tree across continuation pages or invent a code tree when no code root resolves.
statement: Fresh and resumed paged tree reads forward the resolved CodeTree including repositoryRoot, code_tree_id, and any dirty working-tree object_directory so anchors are evaluated instead of reported unverifiable.
title: Paged tree reads forward resolved CodeTree and working-tree objects
